FE ideas (community)

Several users report that splitting Cabin into deck / num / side gives +0.01 accuracy on local CV. The PassengerId group prefix (gggg_pp) also encodes group-travel patterns — passengers travelling in a group are more likely to share their outcome.

Caveat: these are forum claims, not reproduced by the host. Treat as community trust level. Verify on a held-out fold before submitting.
